facts.title: regulator directive concerning positive isolation verification at TK-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control FIXED_FIRE_SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY: the availability and testing of fixed fire protection had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the availability and testing of fixed fire protection on TK-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining fire protection systems, specifically maintaining portable and mobile extinguishing equipment. TK-4210 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 22 September 2022 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TK-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following a breakdown response.
